countdown.definition: n. counting backward from an arbitrary number to indicate the time remaining before some event (such as launching a space vehicle)
countdown.translation:
n. 倒计数
[电] 指示串联中的操作数固定的记录减少

countdowns.definition: n. counting backward from an arbitrary number to indicate the time remaining before some event (such as launching a space vehicle)
countdowns.translation: n. （发射宇宙飞船等的）倒数读秒, 倒计时( countdown的复数形式 ); 大事临近的时期
